spatial_reference: Upper/lower name the two fixed WR06 open-shelf levels. Plate left/right name the two fixed task-local regions beside the serving plate, not left/right in an arbitrary camera image.

inspect_shelf.label: inspect the shelf levels to locate the ketchup bottle

pick_lower.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from the lower shelf

pick_upper.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from the upper shelf

place_plate_left.label: place the ketchup bottle upright on the left side of the serving plate

place_plate_right.label: place the ketchup bottle upright on the right side of the serving plate

pick_plate_left.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from the left side of the serving plate

pick_plate_right.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from the right side of the serving plate

return_lower.label: return the ketchup bottle upright to the lower shelf

return_upper.label: return the ketchup bottle upright to the upper shelf
